about: discovery (modes plan D1): the plain game (mod off): Start at 100 (intro or demo -> title, or title -> the Rumble Pak notice), B x3 (the notice -> title), Start at 115 -> the main menu (ready 15-19 s later); down at 140 -> Royal Rumble, A -> ORDER page, A -> NUMBER page, right x3; the run ends on the NUMBER page (its RAM dumped). Run with SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_IGNORE_DEVICES=0x0079/0x0011 so the virtual pads are the game's controllers 1 and 2 (this rig's physical pad otherwise holds 1; the plain title takes only controller 1).
